data.one_liner: Customizable linter library enforcing coding standards for Flutter and Dart apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of recommended lint rules and configuration files from Yumemi Inc. to enhance code quality and maintainability. It includes CLI tools to automatically update lint rules based on the project's Dart or Flutter SDK version.
use_when: You want to enforce YUMEMI Inc.'s coding standards and best practices in your Dart or Flutter project.
You want automated management of recommended lint configurations matching your SDK version.
avoid_when: Your project requires a completely different set of custom-designed lint rules without external preset files.
strengths: Automates updating lint configurations to match current Dart and Flutter SDK versions.
Helps improve code quality and maintainability with established best practices.
weaknesses: Requires manual adjustment or overrides in analysis_options.yaml if default rules conflict.
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dev dependency and run `dart run yumemi_lints update`, then include the recommended yaml in your `analysis_options.yaml` file.
